packageRules.description: Dependabot owns every dependency in this repo. Renovate is here for the single dependency Dependabot cannot see, so disable everything by default and let the allow-rule below opt one dep back in. Without this the two bots race and open duplicate PRs.

The TypeScript 7 compiler is installed as an npm alias (typescript-7 = npm:typescript@^7.0.2). Dependabot silently skips aliased packages in the bun ecosystem (dependabot-core#15847) - no PR, no warning - which is how this pin sat on the moving `rc` dist-tag unnoticed. Renovate covers it. Match on depName, NOT packageName: the alias resolves to packageName `typescript`, which would also match the 6.x compiler-API pin that must stay on 6 until TS 7.1 restores the API.
